question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be implemented now, and what log-stream source, command-output source, scopes, redaction, retention, and export boundary must they use?
rationale: Automation cannot choose whether this should expose only existing read-only logs/output or also introduce new streaming and command-execution capabilities, and the current dashboard substrate is still unmerged.

options.title: Stage after substrate and stream source
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream binding/log-stream RPC first, then implement read-only widgets against approved security contracts.

options.title: Narrow to existing read-only data
options.body: Permit only a focused widget PR that uses existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer bundled dashboard builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage after substrate and stream source
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream binding/log-stream RPC first, then implement read-only widgets against approved security contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal is the Logbook native plugin-tab seam and recent displayed-gateway-logs work that this dashboard surface would extend.
